```sql
WITH state_delivered AS (
  SELECT
    c.state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_delivered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_late = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_delivered
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_key
  WHERE o.is_delivered = TRUE
  GROUP BY c.state
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
)
SELECT
  state,
  ROUND(on_time_delivered * 100.0 / total_delivered, 2) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM state_delivered
ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    d.month_name,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN dim_date d ON o.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND d.date <= DATE '2018-08-31'
  GROUP BY d.month_name, d.year_month
  ORDER BY d.year_month
)
SELECT
  month_name,
  ROUND(
    (
      (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) /
      NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS month_over_month_growth_pct
FROM monthly_revenue;
```

```sql
WITH seller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ds.seller_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) AS delivered_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered AND NOT fo.is_late THEN fo.order_id END) AS on_time_orders
  FROM dim_seller ds
  JOIN fact_order_items foi ON ds.seller_key = foi.seller_key
  JOIN fact_orders fo ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id
  GROUP BY ds.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) >= 100
)
SELECT
  seller_id,
  delivered_orders,
  ROUND(on_time_orders * 100.0 / NULLIF(delivered_orders, 0), 2) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM seller_stats
ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
WITH 
delivered_counts AS (
  SELECT dc.customer_key, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
  FROM dim_customer dc
  JOIN fact_orders fo ON dc.customer_key = fo.customer_key
  WHERE fo.is_delivered = TRUE
  GROUP BY dc.customer_key
),
total_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS total
  FROM dim_customer dc
  JOIN fact_orders fo ON dc.customer_key = fo.customer_key
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) FROM delivered_counts dc WHERE dc.delivered_orders > 1) /
    NULLIF(tc.total, 0),
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM total_customers tc;
```

```sql
WITH cat_rev AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_en AS category,
    SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM fact_order_items oi
  JOIN dim_product p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
  GROUP BY p.category_en
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM cat_rev
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT category, revenue FROM cat_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
),
top10_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top10_revenue FROM top10
)
SELECT ROUND( (t.top10_revenue / tr.total_revenue) * 100, 2 ) AS share_percent
FROM top10_sum t, total_rev tr;
```

```sql
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    d.year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(f.is_late) AS late_orders
  FROM fact_orders f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE (d.year = 2017 AND d.month >= 1) OR (d.year = 2018 AND d.month <= 8)
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.year_month
),
monthly_rate AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    (late_orders * 100.0 / total_orders) AS late_rate_pct
  FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  late_rate_pct
FROM monthly_rate
WHERE late_rate_pct = (SELECT MAX(late_rate_pct) FROM monthly_rate);
```

```sql
WITH total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(price) AS total FROM fact_order_items
),
seller_rev AS (
  SELECT seller_key, SUM(price) AS rev
  FROM fact_order_items
  GROUP BY seller_key
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    seller_key,
    rev,
    SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS cum_rev,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rn
  FROM seller_rev
)
SELECT MIN(rn) AS smallest_num_sellers
FROM ranked, total_rev
WHERE cum_rev >= 0.8 * total;
```

```sql
SELECT
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2018 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END) -
      SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END)) /
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.month = 8;
```

```sql
WITH order_category_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fo.order_id,
    dp.category_en AS category,
    fo.is_delivered,
    fo.is_late
  FROM fact_orders fo
  JOIN fact_order_items foi ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id
  JOIN dim_product dp ON foi.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fo.is_delivered = TRUE
)
SELECT
  category,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_late = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM order_category_distinct
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC
LIMIT 2;
```
